## Problem

What are you trying to do, and where does the current SDK fall short? Describe the underlying problem before jumping to a proposed API — this helps evaluate whether it belongs in the SDK or at the application layer.

## Proposed solution

A description of the API, config option, or behavior you'd like to see. Code sketches welcome:

```ts
// proposed usage
```

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you're currently using, or other approaches you considered.

## Additional context

Does this affect a documented default (see the README's "Privacy, consent & data collection defaults" or "Caching model" sections)? If so, please call that out explicitly — changes to documented defaults get extra review.
